title: Consolidate button state tokens and theme anchors for coherent loading/disabled/icon behavior
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Button behavior across themes and variants has diverged after several incremental changes. Loading indicators, disabled visuals, and icon-only sizing are inconsistent across light/dark/brand themes, causing subtle regressions in product apps (notably the console routes and Dedicated UI).

Goal: Create a single, explicit system of tokens and rules (theme anchors) that define: base/button colors, disabled overlays, loading spinner color/placement, icon-button hit target & spacing, and priority variant treatments. Ship updated token mappings and a components migration guide so frontend engineers can adopt without visual regressions.

Constraints: Keep existing public API (classNames / variant props) unchanged where possible; prefer token remapping and internal component fallbacks. Ensure WCAG contrast for disabled states where required by policy.

Scope: tokens for primary/secondary/ghost/destructive, icon-button sizes (sm/md/lg), loading spinner alignment for text/icon combos, disabled overlay spec, theme anchor variables for light/dark/brand, and regression fixes called out by QA (see comments).
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens defined: --button-bg-{variant}, --button-border-{variant}, --button-text-{variant}, --button-disabled-overlay, --button-loading-color for each theme
Icon-button spacing and hit-target documented and implemented for sm/md/lg with visual specs and code snippets
Loading state uses spinner color token and reserves text width to avoid layout shift for primary and secondary variants
Disabled state uses overlay token with contrast checks; contrast report attached showing WCAG AA/AAA where applicable
Regression gallery: old vs new screenshots for 12 representative screens (console, dedicated capacity pages, signup flows) with approval from PM
Migration doc published in Design System repo and linked in this ticket
A companion small staff-engineering PR merges with patch-level changes and passes visual diffs in Percy/Chromatic
design_notes: Prefer additive tokens (theme anchors) rather than per-component bespoke colors to simplify overrides for Private deployments
Introduce --button-icon-spacing and --button-icon-only-size tokens so icon-only buttons don’t rely on manual padding hacks
Loading spinner should be absolute-positioned with a reserved inline width equal to average of glyph+padding to avoid layout shift on start/stop
Disabled state should not reduce text contrast below 3:1 for body-small labels used in admin panels; where contrast drops below target, use an explicit low-interaction variant instead
Document fallback priority: explicit prop -> variant token -> theme anchor -> global tokens
tasks: Finalize token names and export map (design)
Prototype updated components in new DS figma file (figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/DS-v3-Buttons)
Produce contrast report for disabled states (tools: Axe / contrast-checker)
Write migration guide and code examples for React button component
Partner with ENG to add token hooks to runtime theme loader and add unit tests
Create visual regression suite of 12 screens and run Chromatic/Percy baselines
Ship small compatibility shim in JS that maps old token names to new anchors for 2 releases
